messages:
alex_t: CI turned red on my PR after merge. integration-tests:gpu-flaky failed with OOM during model-load. build 123456. any quick tips?
maria_g: on it, sending a quick look.
samir: if it's flaky we usually avoid a full artifact rebuild. use the retry wrapper.
alex_t: what's the exact command? last time retry rebuilt the docker image and that took ages.
ci-bot: quick help: `ci retry --jobs=integration-tests:gpu-flaky --build 123456 --skip-image-build` will requeue the job reusing the existing artifact when available.
jing_w: also `ci retry --task=model-load --build 123456 --skip-image-build` works on task-level for supported runners. narrower retries reduce noise.
maria_g: step-by-step: 1) confirm failing job id in the build UI (123456). 2) run the `ci retry --jobs=integration-tests:gpu-flaky --build 123456 --skip-image-build`. 3) monitor with `ci watch 123456` or open the build link.
alex_t: running now...
alex_t: ```
$ ci retry --jobs=integration-tests:gpu-flaky --build 123456 --skip-image-build
Retrying jobs on build 123456 — reusing artifact sha 9b2c4ef
Queued new build: https://ci.redwood.dev/builds/123457
```
ci-bot: Reaction :rocket: queued 123457
samir: if it fails again and reproduces locally, do a bisect: `git bisect start -- bad 9b2c4ef -- good <last-good>` then loop with `ci run --commit <sha> --jobs=integration-tests:gpu-flaky --skip-image-build`.
jing_w: and try an env tweak if you suspect memory pressure: `ci retry --build 123456 --jobs=integration-tests:gpu-flaky --env=CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 --skip-image-build` or set `FORCE_CUDA_MEM=6000`.
alex_t: second attempt passed. looks transient.
maria_g: great — i'll leave a short PR comment summarizing the rerun and link INFRA-342 we opened for noisy GPU nodes.
ops-bot: INFRA-342 created, linked to build 123456 and investigation notes.
samir: tl;dr for the channel: prefer `--skip-image-build` (fast), use `--task` to narrow, bisect when reproducible, and open infra ticket for noisy nodes.
alex_t: thanks all, closing the loop :thumbsup:
